quest.title: Fieldwise Mastery, Unyielding Progress!
quest.description: At Collei's invitation, you and Paimon arrive at the venue of the Akademiya's newly-established "Fieldwise Center," ready to participate in its further development...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon! Over here!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Welcome to the home base of the "Fieldwise Center"!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: As you can see, the core projects are already up and running, so we can get to work at any time!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... This feels like... one of those places light novels talk about. Y'know, the adventuring hubs where rookies gather to take quests and stuff?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! And almost like a school festival at the same time, with everyone getting together to learn and then forming teams to hone their skills... Hehe, it's so exciting!

choices.text: Yeah, I'm pumped!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Well, this place isn't quite as decked out as a school festival, but Master Tighnari said the Akademiya plans to be generous with the resources.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Anyway, before students and researchers head out on dangerous field missions, they can come here for advice and emergency training...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: We even have professionals on staff that can join their teams to serve as guides or safety personnel.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Yeah, you can think of it like a "Forward Operating Base" — equal parts theoretical training and field practice!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: We'll familiarize new recruits with potential challenges in the wild and take them through drills so there's no reason to panic during the real thing!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Amber? You're here, too?

choices.text: Is the Outrider getting new job responsibilities?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Haha, surprised? I know I was!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: I'm off duty right now, so I was planning to just drop in on Collei for a bit...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: But, I didn't realize how busy she'd be! I'm not the type of person to sit around and watch. So, I decided to be her assistant!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Sorry, Amber. I didn't mean to put you to work during your time off...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Don't worry about it! A little relaxation balanced out with some fulfilling work is a great vacation in my book! Plus, I've learned a whole bunch of stuff, too!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: #And, I got to see {NICKNAME} and Paimon again! I mean, it just keeps getting better!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: We should have a giant feast once we're done here. How does that sound?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, a feast with the first friend we met in Sumeru, and the first friend we met on our whole journey...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That sounds just about as awesome as a giant plate of Sticky Honey Roast!

choices.text: Well, we should get this show on the road, then.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Alright! Down to business, then...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Collei and I are in charge of the scouting speedsters project. The focus is using devices and machines to pass through hazardous areas, survey terrain, and get details on potential threats.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Plus, Amurta research indicates that, during dangerous situations, having the support of an adorable companion can help set adventurers' minds at ease and prevent excess nerves...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: So, we took inspiration from Cuilein-Anbar and Baron Bunny to create two scouting devices that are both adorable and useful — "Cuilein An-bot" and "Bar-drone Bunny". So far, feedback has been pretty positive!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Once we've collected enough data, the Akademiya will continue to refine the Scouting Buddies and release even more designs!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A bunch of Cuilien-Anbars and Baron Bunnies running around the wilderness... What is that gonna look like?

choices.text: Like a sight for sore eyes, no doubt!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Plus, with you to guide our two little scouts, we'll be able to obtain some great data.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Once you have a more complete understanding of the Fieldwise Center, you should come test them out.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Now, come with me. I'll introduce you to the other consultants.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Oh, yeah! The lady with the greenish-blue hair also has a super adorable device over there!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: But, it does something completely different than our scouting buddies.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: I'm looking forward to seeing it in action!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, hey! Another familiar face!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon! Let's go say hi!

choices.text: It's kind of hard to picture...
Let's work hard, so we can feast harder.
You've been calling in reinforcements from far and wide, Collei!
What kind of light novels have you been reading, Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: ...It's really that popular?

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: The internal locomotion mechanism is clever enough, and the execution on the terrain recognition, remote control, and weight detection modules isn't bad...

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: But, the appearance... It might as well be a doll for a child. No, this won't do...

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Madam Faruzan! Great news—

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon agreed to join! The Fieldwise Center just leveled up big time, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe! Hello, Madam Faruzan! We're here to help!

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Well, look who the cat dragged in...

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Excellent job, Collei! Snagging two top experts with undeniable adventuring expertise... Now, the League won't be able to say a word, no matter what kind of feedback I give!

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Now, tell me... What do you think of this "Puzzlepal"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... It looks just like you!

choices.text: It makes me feel safe and comfortable.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: It's a collaboration between my juniors in the Haravatat Darshan, the Puzzlers' League, and the Synopsium on Ruin Mechanisms.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Clearly, the technological aspect is quite advanced, but the appearance... it couldn't be more childish.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: You should've seen Anis! Defending this design choice with more passion than her thesis...

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Hmph, young people these days... Far too obsessed with making things cute.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, Paimon kinda likes it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Collei and Amber were just saying how cute companions can help adventurers stay calm.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: With a doll that looks like you by her side, Paimon thinks she could go adventuring in a super dark ruin and not even get scared...

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Well, that line of thinking does have merit. And, I suppose choosing this particular appearance is a sign of their respect... Ahem, for me.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Still, there are adventurers who place greater emphasis on reliability and technical composition.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: People like that don't just want their devices to be able to survive an avalanche, but to look the part... and for their appearance to reflect the high-tech composition.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: The fluffiness of this Puzzlepal, on the other hand, doesn't give the impression it would be a reliable or formidable device. The appearance may even be distracting.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Now, picture this... A thick metal casing, square in shape, with a matte finish and openings to showcase the complex technical composition... That would have much more visual impact.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: I'm the perfect example of this. I have a youthful appearance, and so people question me on occasion. If I had a head of white hair instead, things would be different.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: R—Really? Then, do you want Paimon to talk to them? She has white hair...

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: What? No! That... That's not the same thing!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Uh... I didn't realize you had such... strict views about this, Madam Faruzan.

choices.text: I think it looks good as it is.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Huh? So... even you prefer this version?

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Ahem... Well...

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: If that's what you really think, then... Fine!

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: #You'll have to come back and test it out on some puzzles, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: I'll rate your effectiveness in using the device and come up with a user manual based on your performance...

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: As for improvements to its appearance, long-term observation is required, so I'll put that aside for now.

choices.text: I'll do my best!

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: I've already selected a few of the most suitable Domains, so we can begin the puzzle-solving process at any time.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: #Thanks, Madam Faruzan. I'm just gonna take {NICKNAME} and Paimon to see the final project... But, it shouldn't take long!

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Don't worry, Collei! You're the one in charge here, just make sure to pace yourself.

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Once things calm down, come over to see me, and we'll have a nice chat. I'll even treat you to some snacks from back in my day.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Snacks!? Paimon's in, Paimon's in!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Thank you, Madam Faruzan. I'll bring a few boxes of floral tea as well!

response.speaker: Faruzan
response.text: Go on now. Do me proud!

choices.text: I'll be sure to make the most of the Puzzlepal's capabilities!
Maybe we can save the square model for next time.
It barely looks like adventuring gear at all.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: This last one is a long-term project we're calling the Security Division.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Thanks to General Mahamatra Cyno, we've been able to bring Dehya on as the instructor and Candace as the coordinator.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: They're putting together a combat test right now, but they should be back soon...

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: Hey! Looking for us? Guess we showed up right on cue, then!

dialogues.speaker: Dehya
dialogues.text: #Wait, {NICKNAME} and Paimon are joining as well? That makes things a whole lot easier!

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: Sorry for keeping you waiting, everyone, but we managed to bring back some good intel.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Intel? Whew, this is starting to sound intense.

choices.text: That's the type of prep you do before a major battle...

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Of course! What better way to protect the students than to sweep through the desert and rid it of all potential dangers! Not a bad plan, right? You in?

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: Not the best time for jokes, Dehya.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: #Besides, when it comes to striking down danger, {NICKNAME} is a {M#man}{F#woman} on a mission. {M#He}{F#She} might take you up on that offer...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Defeating anything that might pose a threat... Even if {NICKNAME} worked non-stop, that could still take years!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'd have to stop traveling... Paimon doesn't even wanna think about that...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Time would be the least of our problems. Some dangers aren't visible to the naked eye, like the scorpions burrowed underground, or the terrifying raptors sleeping in the trees...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: You can't get rid of them until they jump out to attack you!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: For situations like these, we'd have to combine Madam Faruzan's recommendations with Amber's approach to scouting, calculating our chances of encountering enemies and our expected operation times...

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa. Pencils down, everyone! That was just a joke!

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: The Security Division's goal is a lot simpler, actually. We're just here to ensure that field work teams include trained combat personnel.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: Some of this work has been entrusted to the Blazing Beasts and other mercenaries, but members of investigation teams who pass the combat test can also qualify.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: Before an investigation team is allowed to head into a dangerous area, the group must include at least two professionals who have passed the assessment.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: And, Dehya and I were just out collecting intel on the best place to hold the test.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: We found a Domain filled with monsters and bandits of all levels. Hopefully, they don't mind us borrowing their stomping ground for bit. It'll only cost 'em a few smacks on the head, haha.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so we just need to supervise, right?

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: That's right. Participant safety is our utmost priority, so we'll organize a group of capable personnel to take it in shifts.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: We still need to figure out our testing metrics, though. Fighting is different from an actual exam — and there's no one right answer.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Mercenaries like me... We all have our own style. That's not a problem in actual combat, but when it comes to teaching... We tend to stick too much to what we're used to.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: So we need someone to give us a baseline... someone who has the experience but also takes a more flexible approach in combat.

choices.text: That's my specialty! Leave it to me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Yeah, based on what you just described, {NICKNAME} seems like the perfect person for the job!

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: #Great! Working with you is always a pleasure, {NICKNAME} — smooth as butter on a steak!

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: #Don't forget about compensation for {NICKNAME} and Paimon, Dehya. You agreed without doing the math first.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Ah, it's fine! We'll just split the funds Collei wrangled for us twenty-eighty. Ten for me, ten for you, eighty for the two of them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, we're getting eighty percent?

choices.text: That seems like a bit much...

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: Hahaha! Don't sweat it!

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: We're just in charge of the long-term operations. You're the ones setting the metrics for the whole thing, so I think we got the better end of the deal, haha.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: We've talked about a partnership in the past, haven't we? Well then, consider this the perfect place to start.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Th—Then, I'll draw up a detailed overview of the compensation so it's clear for everyone.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: That'd be great!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: And don't worry, Miss Candace.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: About that piece of land you're leasing to the Akademiya, the one used for grain storage... I managed to get them to agree to a thirty percent increase in the rent payment.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: Ah, thank you. Those funds will go to fixing up some of the village facilities, which should make for a more comfortable experience when investigation teams stop there in the future.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: #Alright, we should finish up our arrangements for the combat test. Stop by our station when you're ready, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Dehya
response.text: See you soon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, you sure are the beating heart of this operation, Collei! You brought the whole gang together!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Oh, no, no... I'm just doing what I can.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: I still have so much to learn, so much work to coordinate...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: But, for now, let's just give it our all!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You bet! Hehe, we'll make the Fieldwise Center the best it can be!

choices.text: Thank you for your generosity, Dehya!
I'm here to help as much as I can.
Are we planning some sort of offensive?

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Hmm... Perhaps we shouldn't change it after all...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Hmm, I should adjust the legs so Bar-drone Bunny can run even faster!
